primary_finite_metric: subject-mean RMS centered-logit displacement under finite erasure/offset
primary_local_metric: centered-logit Jacobian energy per canonical dimension

statistical_units.dda_a: held subject; hierarchically aggregated within run
statistical_units.dda_b: run x frozen Protected block after subject aggregation
statistical_units.dda_c: run x audit-fold x block; outcome and decision subjects disjoint

controls.dda_a: 100 exact-norm random offsets in the same TRAIN-derived blockwise G-perp admissible space
controls.dda_b: 100 same-rank random subspaces with per-sample representation-displacement norm matching, plus same-rank non-PROTECTED blocks

dda_a_gate.rule: representation movement AND (all three absolute equivalence tests OR matched-random ratio test)

dda_c_gate.target: held-subject mean signed CE consequence of block erasure

crossfit.dda_bc: for k=0..4: decision=k, outcome=(k+1)%5, model-fit=remaining 3 subject folds
